interfaces: The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.

evidence: Specifically designed to mount one or two NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series products side-by-side

The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.
All mounting hardware provided: rack, brackets, blanking plates, rails, lacing bar, handles and screws.
Specifically designed for organizing NetworkHD components within the main rack location, the NHD-RACK-1U de-clutters the rack, improving cable management, port identification and unit access.

featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The NHD-RACK-1U is a compact 1U rack mount unit specifically engineered to deliver a sleek, organized installation solution for up to 2 NetworkHD 100/500/600 Series and NHD-CTL-PRO v2 devices. Designed with precision, this rack mount ensures that your NetworkHD components are securely housed while maintaining optimal airflow and accessibility for maintenance. The 1U 2 Slot Rack offers exceptional flexibility, allowing scaling setup by selecting the exact number of racks needed based on the quantity of devices in the NetworkHD system—whether deploying a small-scale configuration or expanding to support a larger network infrastructure.

Horizontal slot installation supports combination of 2 NetworkHD Series 100/500/600 components or NHD-CTL-PRO v2 providing ideal component heat dissipation and airflow – a key factor in increasing reliability and product lifespan.
All mounting hardware provided: rack, brackets, blanking plates, rails, lacing bar, handles and screws.
Specifically designed for organizing NetworkHD components within the main rack location, the NHD-RACK-1U de-clutters the rack, improving cable management, port identification and unit access.
